subject.title: feat: add i18n support with zh-CN (Simplified Chinese) locale

question: Should ClawHub commit to maintaining app-level localization now, beginning with zh-CN, and what translation ownership model should govern future UI changes?
rationale: The feature is directionally compatible with web ergonomics but spans most of the product shell and creates a permanent maintenance obligation; both previous full implementations closed unmerged after maintainer discussion.

options.title: Defer localization
options.body: Keep the application English-only until a maintainer sponsors translation ownership, rollout priority, and review capacity.

options.title: Approve staged foundation
options.body: Sponsor a focused specification and infrastructure PR before translating the complete application surface.

options.title: Approve full zh-CN rollout
options.body: Commit to complete English and zh-CN parity with an ongoing native-language review process for every user-facing change.

recommendation.title: Defer localization
recommendation.body: Keep the application English-only until a maintainer sponsors translation ownership, rollout priority, and review capacity.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest decision owner from the related implementation reviews and this issue's tracking discussion.
